lines.rom: arati kijai sri raghuvara ji ki sat cit ananda siva sundara ki
dasaratha tanaya kausalya nandana sura muni raksaka daitya nikandana anugata bhakta bhakta ura candana maryada purusotama vara ki
nirguna saguna anupa rupa nidhi sakala loka vandita vibhinna vidhi harana soka bhaya dayaka nava nidhi maya rahita divya nara vara ki
janaki pati sura adhipati jagapati akhila loka palaka triloka gati visva vandya avanha amita gati eka matra gati sacaracara ki
